relations.condition: Japanese manufacturing PMI remained comfortably within growth territory at 54.3 in October
Housing starts in Japan were up at the margin in September, although they remained down notably on a year-on-year basis
Vehicle production in Japan was down year-on-year in September, but the rate of decline slowed further and was the lowest this year-to-date
Industrial production in Japan was up in September month-on-month, for the seventh consecutive month
Base metals consumption in China has grown rapidly so far this year, and the latest economic data remains uniformly positive
Real GDP growth in China accelerated in the third quarter to 8.9%
Industrial production in China grew to 13.9% in September (compared to 12.3% in August)
China’s manufacturing PMI rose further in October to 55.4, compared to 55 in the previous month
Brazil’s manufacturing PMI at 52.3 in October, suggesting an expansion
India’s manufacturing PMI at 54.5 in October, suggesting an expansion
Russia’s manufacturing PMI saw a return below the 50 mark, largely as a result of weak export orders
